ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels covering approximately 90% of the fluke surface, contrasted with high-intensity (white) localized pixel regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct high-intensity curvilinear arc spanning the mid-medial to upper-distal region of the right lobe. High-intensity punctate clusters located at the extreme left and right distal tips. Scattered small white pixel clusters across the mid-medial section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep interior angle (~45-55 degrees) and sharp convergence at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency irregular serration across the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitude variations manifest as jagged peaks and valleys isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature tapering from the center toward the distal tips, maintaining a consistent upward arc profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips (consistent with barnacle-related scarring). Several smaller, roughly circular high-contrast dots localized on the medial right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Primary high-intensity white curvilinear scar on the right lobe. At least three faint, vertically aligned linear pixel disruptions on the mid-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant curvilinear high-contrast mark on the right lobe; prominent white scarring/encrustation at the extreme left and right lobe terminals.
other_distinctive_markers: Strongly defined vertical ridge-line extending from the peduncle base toward the median notch.
